detail.longDescription: New in adaptive-agent-memory-research: a ladder that adds one memory component per rung, each rung compared with a random-bank control that shows the same amount of text picked at random. Rung 2 asks whether any domain example helps, before rung 5 tries matching by current state. No GPU needed for the random-bank control arm, a good first task under the ladder v1 milestone. # AIagents # OpenScience https:// github.com/krapcys1-maker/adap tive-agent-memory-research
